---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a focused HandleScope improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## User problem

What is difficult today, and who is affected?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the narrowest useful behavior and its user confirmation flow.

## Security and privacy impact

Does this broaden process or handle selection, add elevation or persistence,
write new local data, add network access, expose diagnostic information, change
signing or updates, or add a dependency? Explain the minimum required access
and a fail-closed design.

## Test boundary

Describe how the behavior can be tested using only a child process and objects
created by the test itself.

## Alternatives

What existing workflow or smaller change could address the problem?
